block.sanupcraft.guardian_altar.busy: A boss is already nearby (within 48 blocks).
block.sanupcraft.guardian_altar.too_cold: Too cold here. The Furnace Warden only wakes in the Nether.
commands.sanupcraft.config.reloaded_warn: Reloaded %s · %s warning(s) (bad values fall back to defaults)
advancements.sanupcraft.root.title: Sanupcraft
advancements.sanupcraft.root.description: Factories open boss fights, bosses open factories. Start by mining iron.
advancements.sanupcraft.rusted_shrine.de: Find a Rusted Shrine in plains or forests. Its chest holds a Guardian Summoner
advancements.sanupcraft.crusher.title: Double and More
advancements.sanupcraft.crusher.descript: Raw ore → 2 dust, sometimes another metal. Crush coal too (steel ingredient). Next, a Press (5 iron ingots, a piston, 3 cobblestone). Hoppers: top input, side fuel, bottom output.
advancements.sanupcraft.iron_plate.title: Parts Bin
advancements.sanupcraft.iron_plate.descr: An Assembler turns steel plates into machine parts.
advancements.sanupcraft.steel.title: Rustproof
advancements.sanupcraft.steel.descriptio: A full steel set blocks rust attacks. Place a Guardian Altar and right-click it with a Summoning Stone to wake the Rusty Guardian (the stone is used up).
advancements.sanupcraft.guardian_core.de: One core = one Reinforced Machine Frame, or 4 core shards in a Crusher. Frames and shards go into many things, so expect to hunt the guardian several times.
advancements.sanupcraft.boiler.title: Full Steam
advancements.sanupcraft.boiler.descripti: Pour in a water bucket or place it next to a water source, then add fuel. Machines on the pipes run without fuel. Empty-hand right-click: status.
advancements.sanupcraft.belt_motor.title: Assembly Line
advancements.sanupcraft.belt_motor.descr: A motor runs the belts it touches (up to 32). Belts carry toward their front and insert into the chest or machine at the end. Sneaking stops you from being pushed.
advancements.sanupcraft.heatproof.title: Fireproof
advancements.sanupcraft.heatproof.descri: Heatproof = steel gear + machine parts + core shards (enchantments are lost). It still blocks rust attacks, and a full set resists fire and lava. Find blaze rods in a Nether fortress.
The Furnace Warden only wakes in the heat of the Nether. Build an altar there. Nether fortress chests may hold one too.
advancements.sanupcraft.warden_heart.des: Defeat the Furnace Warden. Its heart builds a Heart Forge.
advancements.sanupcraft.heart_forge.desc: Ancient debris → 2 netherite scrap, blaze rod → 4 blaze powder. Craft eyes of ender and head for the End.
advancements.sanupcraft.shulker_shell.de: Shulker shells from End cities make Ender Senders and Receivers.
advancements.sanupcraft.ender_link.title: Across Dimensions
advancements.sanupcraft.ender_link.descr: Dye a sender (needs a Warden's Heart) and a receiver the same color. Items cross dimensions, but the receiver side must be loaded (an ender anchor can keep it loaded).
advancements.sanupcraft.raw_iron.title: Iron Age
advancements.sanupcraft.raw_iron.descrip: Mine raw iron. A Crusher (3 iron ingots, 2 flint, 4 cobblestone) turns it into 2 dust plus byproducts.
advancements.sanupcraft.alloy.title: Not in Vanilla
advancements.sanupcraft.alloy.descriptio: Steel! Armor set 24 · hammer 6 · sword 2 (1 steel = 1 raw iron + 1 coal). Press steel into plates, then assemble machine parts.
advancements.sanupcraft.hammer.title: Nine at Once
advancements.sanupcraft.hammer.descripti: Digs 3x3 (sneak for one block). 60% speed, and much harder blocks are left behind.
advancements.sanupcraft.quarry.title: The Ground Digs Itself
advancements.sanupcraft.quarry.descripti: Steam from pipes, a chest or belt on top. It digs the 9x9 below down to the bottom, so watch your step. Blocks an iron pickaxe cannot mine are left alone.
advancements.sanupcraft.press.title: Plate Maker
advancements.sanupcraft.press.descriptio: Press: iron ingot → iron plate. Alloy Smelter = 6 iron plates + 2 furnaces + blast furnace.
block.sanupcraft.guardian_altar.no_room: Not enough room: clear 3x3 and 4 blocks high above the altar.
block.sanupcraft.guardian_altar.peaceful: Bosses do not wake on Peaceful.
entity.sanupcraft.rusty_guardian.rust_wa: Rusted! Without a full steel set you take 1.5x damage and slowness.
entity.sanupcraft.furnace_warden.heat_wa: Overheated! Without a full heatproof set you take 1.5x damage and burn.
block.sanupcraft.boiler.other_fuel: It holds a different fuel. You can only add the same fuel.
block.sanupcraft.boiler.hint.no_water: No water: pour a bucket or place it next to a water source
block.sanupcraft.boiler.hint.steam_full: Steam full: it only burns fuel as steam is used

block.sanupcraft.steam_quarry.drill_alre: A heatproof drill is already installed

block.sanupcraft.tank.other_fluid: Holds a different fluid (one kind only)

block.sanupcraft.pump.hint.no_source: No source: no water or lava source within radius %1$s (same level and below)

block.sanupcraft.ender_link.lock_off: Unlocked: anyone can open it or change the channel · Channel %s
gui.sanupcraft.machine.slot.fuel: Fuel (hopper: side) · not needed with steam
gui.sanupcraft.machine.slot.upgrade: Upgrade (by hand only · two of the same apply twice)
block.sanupcraft.crusher.tooltip: Raw ore → 2 dust · ore block → 3 dust · coal, charcoal → coal dust
block.sanupcraft.crusher.tooltip2: Cobblestone → gravel · gravel → sand · bone → bone meal · Guardian Core → 4 shards
block.sanupcraft.press.tooltip: Iron ingot → iron plate · steel ingot → steel plate · iron plate → 4 rivets
block.sanupcraft.alloy_smelter.tooltip: 2 iron dust + 2 coal dust → steel ingot
block.sanupcraft.heart_forge.tooltip: Ancient debris → 2 netherite scrap · blaze rod → 4 blaze powder
item.sanupcraft.steel_helmet.tooltip: Full set: blocks the Rusty Guardian's rust attack (1.5x damage, slowness)
item.sanupcraft.steel_chestplate.tooltip: Full set: blocks the Rusty Guardian's rust attack (1.5x damage, slowness)
item.sanupcraft.steel_leggings.tooltip: Full set: blocks the Rusty Guardian's rust attack (1.5x damage, slowness)
item.sanupcraft.steel_boots.tooltip: Full set: blocks the Rusty Guardian's rust attack (1.5x damage, slowness)
item.sanupcraft.heatproof_helmet.tooltip: Full set: fire resistance, blocks overheating and rust attacks (instead of a steel set)
item.sanupcraft.heatproof_chestplate.too: Full set: fire resistance, blocks overheating and rust attacks (instead of a steel set)
item.sanupcraft.heatproof_leggings.toolt: Full set: fire resistance, blocks overheating and rust attacks (instead of a steel set)
item.sanupcraft.heatproof_boots.tooltip: Full set: fire resistance, blocks overheating and rust attacks (instead of a steel set)
item.sanupcraft.heatproof_sword.tooltip: 1.5x damage to the Rusty Guardian and the Furnace Warden
item.sanupcraft.guardian_summoner.toolti: Right-click a Guardian Altar to summon the Rusty Guardian (used up)
item.sanupcraft.warden_summoner.tooltip: Right-click a Guardian Altar in the Nether to summon the Furnace Warden (used up)
item.sanupcraft.guardian_core.tooltip: Reinforced Machine Frame ingredient · Crusher → 4 core shards
block.sanupcraft.boiler.tooltip: Water + fuel → steam · empty-hand right-click: status
block.sanupcraft.steam_quarry.tooltip: Digs the 9x9 below to the bottom · steam + chest or belt on top
block.sanupcraft.steam_quarry.tooltip2: Sneak + empty hand: toggle discarding stone and dirt (on by default)
block.sanupcraft.conveyor_belt.tooltip: Carries toward its front · needs a Belt Motor
block.sanupcraft.belt_sorter.tooltip: Place it in a belt line · items matching the filter go left, the rest go forward
block.sanupcraft.belt_sorter.tooltip2: Right-click: 9 filter slots (click with an item to set a sample) · waits when blocked
block.sanupcraft.filter_hopper.tooltip: Works like a hopper · only items matching the 5 filter slots pass (empty filter = everything)
block.sanupcraft.filter_hopper.tooltip2: Right-click: open the filter (click with an item to set a sample)
item.sanupcraft.ore_marker.tooltip: In a filter slot it matches every raw ore and ore block
item.sanupcraft.steam_canister.tooltip: Fill it at a charger · the rivet gun draws steam from canisters in your inventory
item.sanupcraft.rivet.tooltip: Rivet gun ammo · press: iron plate → 4 rivets
item.sanupcraft.rivet_gun.tooltip: Right-click: 1 rivet + 20 steam (inventory canisters) → fast rivet, 6 damage
item.sanupcraft.steam_boots.tooltip: Sneak in mid-air to dash where you look (40 steam · 1s cooldown)
item.sanupcraft.steam_boots.tooltip2: With steam, fall damage is halved (1 heart = 5 steam) · fill at a charger
item.sanupcraft.steam_boots.tooltip3: Same armor as steel boots · counts as the boots of a steel set
block.sanupcraft.steam_charger.tooltip: Connect a steam pipe and place a steam canister or steam boots on it to fill them (20 per tick)
block.sanupcraft.steam_charger.tooltip2: Empty hand: take it out (sneak: status) · hopper: insert when empty, extract when full
item.sanupcraft.speed_upgrade.tooltip: Goes in the upgrade slots on the left of a machine · processes 1.5x faster (steam and fuel per tick also 1.5x)
item.sanupcraft.speed_upgrade.tooltip2: Two of the same apply twice (multiplied)
item.sanupcraft.efficiency_upgrade.toolt: Goes in the upgrade slots on the left of a machine · uses 30% less steam and fuel
Two of the same apply twice (multiplied)
item.sanupcraft.double_upgrade.tooltip: Goes in the upgrade slots on the left of a machine · 25% chance of one extra result
item.sanupcraft.double_upgrade.tooltip2: Two roll separately (up to +2) · needs room in the result slot
block.sanupcraft.pump.tooltip: Runs on steam · sucks up water or lava sources within radius 5 below (1 bucket per second, 40 steam), holds 8 buckets
block.sanupcraft.pump.tooltip2: Sends it to adjacent tanks and boilers (water) · empty hand: status · empty bucket: take some out
block.sanupcraft.tank.tooltip: Holds up to 16 buckets of water or lava · fill and empty with buckets · comparator reads the fill
block.sanupcraft.tank.tooltip2: An adjacent boiler draws water from it; an adjacent geothermal vent counts 1+ bucket of lava as a lava source
block.sanupcraft.ender_sender.tooltip: Sends on a dye color channel · the receiver side must be loaded
block.sanupcraft.ender_sender.tooltip2: Sneak + empty hand: lock / unlock (placer only)
block.sanupcraft.ender_receiver.tooltip: Receives on a dye color channel · must be loaded to receive
block.sanupcraft.ender_receiver.tooltip2: Sneak + empty hand: lock / unlock (placer only)
block.sanupcraft.crusher.tooltip3: Nether: quartz ore → 2 quartz · nether gold ore → gold dust · glowstone → 4 dust · magma block → 2 magma cream
block.sanupcraft.geothermal_vent.tooltip: Nether only · 2 steam per tick for each touching lava source (max 8) · no water or fuel
Connect with steam pipes · empty hand: status
block.sanupcraft.steam_gauge.tooltip: Attach to a machine, boiler, vent, quarry or belt motor · comparator signal (0-15) = steam fill
block.sanupcraft.steam_gauge.tooltip2: Empty hand: stored steam · steam received in the last second
item.sanupcraft.heatproof_drill.tooltip: Use on a steam quarry → diamond pickaxe tier (ancient debris, obsidian)
block.sanupcraft.ender_anchor.tooltip: 1 popped chorus fruit = 10 min · keeps the 3x3 chunks around it loaded
block.sanupcraft.ender_anchor.tooltip2: Keeps an unattended Nether outpost and ender receivers running
You cannot place water in the Nether. Put a geothermal vent next to lava sources for steam without water or fuel — power for a Nether outpost.
advancements.sanupcraft.steam_gauge.desc: Attach a steam gauge to a machine or boiler to read its steam fill as a comparator signal. Empty hand: see how much steam arrived in the last second.
advancements.sanupcraft.belt_sorter.desc: Craft a belt sorter or a filter hopper. The sorter sends filtered items left and the rest forward; the filter hopper only lets matching items through. An ore marker in a filter slot matches every raw ore and ore block.
advancements.sanupcraft.rivet_gun.title: Ammo from the Factory
advancements.sanupcraft.rivet_gun.descri: Craft a rivet gun. Press iron plates into rivets, and fire them with steam from a canister filled at a steam charger.
advancements.sanupcraft.steam_boots.desc: Craft steam boots. Sneak in mid-air to dash where you look; with steam in them, fall damage is halved.
advancements.sanupcraft.pump.title: Pump It Up
advancements.sanupcraft.pump.description: Craft a pump. It runs on steam, sucks up water and lava sources below and sends them to adjacent tanks and boilers. A lava tank next to a geothermal vent counts as a lava source.
Craft a machine upgrade. Put it in the slots on the left of a machine screen: speed, efficiency or double. Two of the same apply twice.
A quarry with a heatproof drill mines ancient debris. Set one deep in the Nether (Y 8-22) and send the loot home with an ender sender.
advancements.sanupcraft.ender_anchor.des: Build an ender anchor with dragon's breath. Fed popped chorus fruit, it keeps a Nether outpost running with nobody there.
block.sanupcraft.soul_furnace.hint.no_so: must sit on soul sand or soul soil
block.sanupcraft.soul_furnace.hint.full: steam full (connect a precision assembler or turbine with high-pressure pipes)
block.sanupcraft.soul_furnace.tooltip: Only on soul sand / soul soil · 1 blaze powder = 400 high-pressure steam (4/tick)
block.sanupcraft.soul_furnace.tooltip2: No water needed · connect with high-pressure pipes · Empty hand: status
block.sanupcraft.high_pressure_pipe.tool: Soul furnace → precision assembler · steam turbine (high-pressure steam only)
Does not connect to normal steam pipes or machines
block.sanupcraft.steam_turbine.tooltip: 1 high-pressure steam → 3 normal steam (up to 8 high-pressure/tick)
block.sanupcraft.steam_turbine.tooltip2: Connect both a high-pressure pipe and normal steam pipes · Empty hand: status
block.sanupcraft.precision_assembler.too: High-pressure steam only (no fuel slot) · connect a high-pressure pipe
Steel plate + gilded quartz → precision part
item.sanupcraft.gilded_quartz.tooltip: Alloy smelter: nether quartz + 2 gold dust
item.sanupcraft.precision_part.tooltip: Precision assembler: steel plate + gilded quartz · endgame gear material
block.sanupcraft.gold_dispenser.tooltip: Every 3 s throws a gold ingot to the nearest adult piglin within 6 blocks
block.sanupcraft.gold_dispenser.tooltip2: Right-click with gold · hoppers insert · Empty hand: status (sneak: take out)
block.sanupcraft.barter_collector.toolti: Pulls dropped items within 3 blocks into 9 slots (waits 2 s on freshly thrown gold)
Hoppers pull items out · Right-click: 9-slot screen
item.sanupcraft.debris_sonar.tooltip: Right-click: 20 steam → direction · distance of the nearest ancient debris within 16 blocks
item.sanupcraft.debris_sonar.tooltip2: Holds 300 steam · charge it at a steam charger
item.sanupcraft.debris_sonar.no_steam: Not enough steam (%s needed · charge it)
item.sanupcraft.lava_steamboat.tooltip: A boat that floats on water and lava · immune to fire and lava
advancements.sanupcraft.soul_furnace.des: Build a Soul Furnace. Burn blaze powder on soul sand or soul soil for high-pressure steam, which only flows through high-pressure pipes.
advancements.sanupcraft.precision_part.d: Make a Precision Part in the Precision Assembler (steel plate + gilded quartz, high-pressure steam). Endgame gear needs it.
advancements.sanupcraft.debris_sonar.des: Make a Debris Sonar. Right-click to learn the direction and distance of the nearest ancient debris within 16 blocks.
advancements.sanupcraft.lava_steamboat.d: Make a Lava Steamboat and sail across the Nether's lava seas.
advancements.sanupcraft.abandoned_furnac: Find an Abandoned Furnace in the Nether Wastes or Basalt Deltas. Its chest sometimes holds a Warden Summoner.
